## State
- Run 3 (sonnet). cargo-mutants 27.1.0 installed. Full shard 7 (`mutants.sh shared 6`) ~9h: stopped after 8 mutants (7 timeouts in think.rs, 1 caught).
- Per-file runs with `-- --lib --test economy` (think: `--lib --test bots_decide`). s7a = bars+ledger+boundary, 89 mutants: 65 caught, 3 timeout, 14 unviable, 7 missed (68/75 = 90.7%). All 7 test gaps (named x3, is_pity, settle_bars:228, fill_bar:342,359). Tests added and re-run on the 35 mutants of those fns (s7b): 0 missed (25 done at last look).
- Run crate DONE: tests for run_artifact_points, run_node, run_curse_points; seed len 5/6/7; keep max; shop stock; starter one past size. All pass (92 tests). Scan for no-assert tests in run/shared: none (glicko2/practice/bots_cosmetics hits assert via helpers).
- RUNNING: /tmp/batch.sh -> s7c (fleet+math+cosmetic_pack, ~144 mutants, /tmp/s7c.log) then s7d (think). /tmp/batch.done at end. Don't start another cargo mutants.
- TODO: survivors of s7c/s7d -> tests / exclude_re; final checks (fmt done, clippy, tests, spec check); PR text with table. Say shard 7 was scored per file, with test subset named; run crate not re-scored.

## Log
(earlier lines of the log were cut here)
n the report with the reason it has none.
   - Known for the run: `run_artifact_points`, `run_node`, `run_curse_points` are never named in `crates/run/src/*tests.rs`.

8. **The run's limits and weak tests** (`crates/run/src/tests.rs`).
   - Most limits already have tests: seed length (`a_seed_is_six_capital_letters…`), artifact count and points (`a_run_starts_with_at_most_three_artifacts…`), the deck cap (`fight_tests.rs`), campfire removal, pack keep, and artifact level.
   - For each `pub const` in `crates/run/src/config.rs` that a function enforces, confirm a test at, below and past it, using the constant by name:
     - `RUN_SEED_LENGTH`: 5, 6 and 7 letters, through `run_check_setup`.
     - `RUN_STARTER_SIZE`: one under, exact, one over.
     - `RUN_STARTER_ARTIFACTS_MAX` and `RUN_STARTER_ARTIFACT_POINTS`: at, one past.
     - `RUN_KEEP_MAX`: a pack keeps no more than it, even with several "keep more" relics held.
     - `RUN_DECK_MAX`: the fight_tests cases.
     - `RUN_ARTIFACT_LEVEL_MAX`.
     - `RUN_CAMPFIRE_REMOVE`: a deck of 2 and of 3.
     - `RUN_SHRINE_OFFERS`: fewer, equal and more blessings than offers.
     - `RUN_SHOP_CARDS`, `RUN_SHOP_ARTIFACTS` and `RUN_PACK_SIZE`.
   - Add only the missing ones.
   - Cite the section in the test's doc comment: `§15.x` as the existing tests do, or `DR2`, `DR3`, `DR5`–`DR7` from `docs/dungeon-run.md`.
   - Find tests that prove nothing: no assertion, or an assertion that cannot fail (`assert!(x.is_ok() || x.is_err())`, comparing a value with itself). Heuristic: a `#[test]` body with no `assert`, `panic!` or `unwrap_err`. Fix them to assert the real value. Delete a test only when another test already proves the same rule, and name that test in the PR text.
   - Run the same scan over `crates/shared/tests/*.rs` and the in-file modules of the shard's files. Hits to look at first: `glicko2.rs` (`r603_…_reference`), `practice.rs` and `bots_cosmetics.rs` (`r1834005_each_fitted…`), though a helper may do their asserting.
   - Never skip, ignore or weaken a test.

9. **Report the table.** The PR text and your final report carry #3490's table:

```
| module | killed | survived | excluded | score before → after | survivor verdicts |
```

   - One row per module touched: the five shard-7 files, plus any later shard's and the run crate's `lib.rs`.
   - Each survivor left standing gets a verdict and a reason; list "test gap → test `name`" or "equivalent → exclude_re" for the rest.
   - Give each area's total: run (from the earlier #3593 audit, 68.7% → its figure on `main`; re-score only if you re-run it) and shared (shards done on `main` plus yours).
   - Use only numbers you saw printed. Say if a shard did not finish.

## Tests

All new tests are plain `#[test]`s with no ruling number of their own: they cite existing R-ids and §s in doc comments. Do not add a `fn r<n>_…` name unless the note exists and lists the file in `proven_in`, and do not invent a ruling (no new `spec/rulings/` note and no `spec/pending/3513.md` are expected). If a survivor shows an undecided rule, state the decision under Open questions instead.

Name tests for what they assert, e.g. `a_bar_one_point_short_of_its_size_pays_nothing`, `think_ms_at_the_low_end_of_the_window_is_its_floor`, in the file named above.

Commands:
- `cargo test -p jackioh-shared`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-shared --test economy`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-shared --test bots_think`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-run`
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-shared -p jackioh-run --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`
- `cargo jackioh patches check` and `cargo jackioh catalog check`
- Before stopping: `sh scripts/mutants.sh --in-diff` (fails on a survivor in the lines you changed; it is long, so run it last, or skip it if the run was cut off and say so).

## Done when

- [ ] Shard 7 is run, or its finished part scored, and each survivor has a verdict (test, `exclude_re` with a reason, dead code removed, or reported bug).
- [ ] The shared crate's score rises, and so does the run's (or the run's is stated as unchanged, with the reason).
- [ ] The public functions with no test are listed and each now has a test, or is reported with a reason.
- [ ] The run's limits each have an at/below/past test, and tests that prove nothing are fixed or deleted with the reason given.
- [ ] Every new edge-case test cites a DR section, §15/§14 or a ruling.
- [ ] #3490's table is in the final report, from numbers actually printed.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, clippy, the harness's `cargo test`, `spec check`, `patches check` and `catalog check` pass. No `#[ignore]`, no new `#[allow]`, nothing under the forbidden paths.

## Risks

- **Time.**
  - A shard runs for hours. Test survivors as they appear and never leave a half-done file: a file's tests are written and green before you move on.
  - If you must stop early, say how many mutants finished.

- `daily_active_count(profile_id, now) -> i64`: running games + open unlapsed seeks from + open unlapsed challenges from
- `daily_invites_create(&row, now) -> bool`: lapsed open ones of the same key are expired first; false, nothing written, when an open unlapsed one exists (challenge: same from→to; seek: same from, mode, days)
- `daily_invites_get(id) -> Option<DailyInviteRow>`
- `daily_invites_open_of(profile_id, now) -> Vec<DailyInviteRow>`: open unlapsed, sent or received, oldest first
- `daily_invites_close(id, state, match_id: Option<&str>) -> Option<DailyInviteRow>`: from open only, answers the row as it now stands
- `daily_invites_close_between(x, y, state) -> Vec<DailyInviteRow>`: open challenges between them, either way
- `daily_seek_claim(mode, per_move_days, me, match_id, now) -> Option<DailyInviteRow>`: oldest open unlapsed seek of the same mode and days from another profile with no block either way, moved to `paired` with `match_id` (`for update skip locked`)
- `daily_invites_expire(now) -> Vec<DailyInviteRow>`: open ones lapsed by now moved to `expired`
- `daily_notify_get(profile_id) -> DailyNotifyRow` (a missing row is written with defaults: email on, a fresh token)
- `daily_notify_put(profile_id, email_on) -> DailyNotifyRow`
- `daily_notify_sent(profile_id, email_at: Option<i64>, push_at: Option<i64>) -> ()` (each Some is written)
- `daily_notify_unsubscribe(token) -> bool` (email off; false for an unknown or malformed token)
- `push_subs_add(&row) -> ()` (upsert on endpoint)
- `push_subs_of(profile_id) -> Vec<PushSubRow>` oldest first
- `push_subs_delete(endpoint, profile_id: Option<&str>) -> bool` (with Some, only that profile's)

## Goal

`/lobby/:code` is one private-lobby screen for 1v1 lobbies (Best of 1, Conquest, All Random) and co-op lobbies:
- Seats show name, presence, crown and deck state, and an empty seat invites a friend by live toast.
- Each player picks a validated deck, trio or random deck and presses Ready.
- Settings are the host's, and a change clears Ready.
- The host's Start needs every human seat ready, then counts down `LOBBY_START_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS`.
- Leave, Remove; the host leaving closes it; TTLs close an idle one.
- Live over `/ws/social`.

The stage is a new table, `public.lobbies`, and a member holds no seat until Start (R1523000). The lobby panel replaces "Play a friend" and `CoopPanel`. Old links, chat Join and "Open in lobby" open `/lobby/:code`, and a classic room still joins at once. Rulings R3730000–R3730006 record each decision and what it rejects.

All runs used a 4-core machine like CI's, Chrome 156, Cypress 16.1.0 and the job's own command, `pnpm --dir e2e exec cypress run --component --browser chrome`.

- `pnpm --dir apps/edge exec tsc --noEmit -p .` (or `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` if edge has no typecheck script, since `apps/edge/tsconfig.json` exists). This confirms that `containerFetch`'s second argument accepts `{ signal }`.

## Done when

- [ ] A failed check is retried on a request after `IMAGE_CHECK_RETRY_MS`, and an older commit found then is retired.
- [ ] The `/healthz` fetch carries `AbortSignal.timeout(IMAGE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS)`, and a hung check lets the request through.
- [ ] A rejected `stop` or `destroy` logs `server.retire_failed`, and the request and the next one are answered.
- [ ] A check that succeeded is not repeated.
- [ ] The README sentence is added, and the two constants sit beside `RETIRE_WAIT_MS`.
- [ ] `pnpm exec vitest run --project edge`, eslint and the typecheck are green.
- [ ] The harness checks pass (`cargo fmt --check` etc.). No Rust or spec files are touched.

## Risks

- **Check rejecting.** If `retireOlderImage` ever rejected, `imageCheck` would never clear and every request would throw, which is the bug being fixed. Keep every `await` inside it within a `try`. The outer `.then` does not clear on rejection.
- **Concurrent requests.** Concurrent requests share the in-flight `imageCheck`, and a request inside the retry window skips the check without waiting.
- **Timeout in tests.** A native `AbortSignal.timeout` timer is not faked by vitest, so test 4 stubs `AbortSignal.timeout`. Restore it afterwards so other tests are not affected.
- **Rate limit on `/healthz`.** The check is rate-limited by `IMAGE_CHECK_RETRY_MS`, so a down old server is not asked on every request.
- **Conflict with #3618.** Keep edits to `index.ts` to the regions named above.

## Open questions

- The values `IMAGE_CHECK_RETRY_MS = 10_000` and `IMAGE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS = 5_000` are my picks, because the issue names the constants but not their values. 5 s is well under `START_WAIT_MS`, and 10 s keeps a retry from being hit on every request. A person can change them in review.
- Design decision: a failed `stop` or `destroy` also counts as "not checked", so it is retried later, rather than being treated as done. I rejected treating it as done because the old image would then keep serving, which is the problem the issue describes.

## State
Done: index.ts, index.test.ts, README implemented per plan; edge vitest (52), eslint and tsc green. Nothing left.

# Plan (opus, strong)

## Goal

A card set face-down by its Cloaked counts as the Trap it was set as, for every card that answers or counts a play by type (R783005, R1040, R1044, §6.1 Cloaked). `play_counts::record_play` already counts it this way. The scripts and the crafted reveal hat read the printed type instead. Done means:
- one engine read, `query::played_type_of`;
- every play-typing script switched to it, each with an `r783005_` test beside its face-up test;
- the engine test the issue asks for;
- R783005's `proven_in` and the cards README updated;
- a fragment claiming exactly what `classify` confirms.

Where this departs from the sonnet plan:
- **The read is not the live `card_type_of`.** That function answers Unit for anything in a unit zone (R383). Four Field Spells animate as they are played (C+ #12.8, M #66, M #71.1, S #16), so the live read would start Tesla, Knife Juggler and the others firing on them. `record_play` counts those plays as Field Spells because it runs before `animate_on_entry` (`play_steps.rs` ~l.1681). The new read is `alt_play::set_type_of` for a set card, else the face type off the event (the old read).
- **Added:** the crafted hat (`craft.rs:883`), the same bug.
- **Prison:** its kept script keeps the printed read.
- **Unlicensed Experimentation:** reads `played_type_of`, not the live card.
- **Claims:** taken from `classify`'s stage 2, as CI runs it.

## Files to touch

`…` is `crates/cards/src/scripts`.

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `crates/engine/src/query.rs` | new `played_type_of` after `cast_on_draw_event` |
| `crates/engine/src/subsystems/craft.rs` | `reveal_trigger`'s `with_when` reads it |

| `crates/cards/src/lib.rs` | `#[cfg(test)]` `CLOAKED_UNIT`, `set_cloaked` after `stand_in_backrow` |
| `crates/cards/README.md` | row in "The read surface" |
| `…/classic/c006_cloaked_toe_cracker.rs` | read, header line 16 |
| `…/training_grounds/c018_knife_juggler.rs`, `c030_floodgates.rs`, `c014_explosive_trap.rs` | read + test |
| `…/classic/c005_tesla.rs`, `c066_eu_striker.rs` | read + test |
| `…/stinkyscape/c023_warp_disruptor.rs`, `c024_warp_disruptor_ii.rs`, `c135_sacked.rs`, `t_ai_09_honeypot.rs` | read + test |

**Governing rules:** R783005, R1040, R1044, R783008, R383, R77, R767000, §10.5 step 4. No new ruling.

## Steps

0. **Baseline.** Before editing, run `cargo jackioh catalog loc <file>` on each of the 18 scripts and note the counts in `.bot-notes.md`.

1. **`query.rs`:**
   ```rust
   /// R783005, R1040, R1044: the type a `cardPlayed` or `cardResolved` play counts as, as
   /// `play_counts::record_play` counted it (§10.5 step 4): a card set by its Cloaked the Trap it was set
   /// as, any other its face's type off the played definition (B2.7), so an Animated Field Spell that
   /// animated as it entered is still a Field Spell play (R383). A set card off the field is its printed
   /// card (R783008). Scripts typing a play read this, never `def_of(..).type_`; `None` for other events.
   pub fn played_type_of(state: &GameState, event: &GameEvent) -> Option<CardType> {
       let (instance_id, def_id, radiant) = match event {
           GameEvent::CardPlayed { instance_id, def_id, .. } => (instance_id, def_id, None),
           GameEvent::CardResolved { instance_id, def_id, radiant, .. } => (instance_id, def_id, *radiant),
           _ => return None,
       };
       let live = find_instance(state, instance_id);
       if let Some(set) = live.and_then(|card| crate::alt_play::set_type_of(state, card)) {
           return Some(set);
       }
       let radiant = radiant.or_else(|| live.map(|card| card.radiant)).unwrap_or(false);
       Some(crate::faces::card_type_of_face(state, def_id, radiant))
   }
   ```

2. **`craft.rs`, `reveal_trigger`'s `with_when`.**
   - Pattern becomes `CardPlayed { player, .. }`.
   - `let played = crate::query::played_type_of(&*ctx.state, event);` with an `// R783005:` comment.
   - Compare against `Some(CardType::Unit)` and `Some(CardType::Spell)`.

3. **`lib.rs`:**
   ```rust
   #[cfg(test)]
   pub(crate) const CLOAKED_UNIT: &str = "classic-006"; // Cloaked Toe Cracker: a Unit that prints Cloaked

   /// R783004, R783005: sets `card` from `player`'s hand face-down by its Cloaked into backrow `lane`, a
   /// Trap play; the set card's fresh id (R227).
   #[cfg(test)]
   pub(crate) fn set_cloaked(
       s: &mut jackioh_engine::testkit::Scenario,
       player: jackioh_engine::PlayerId,
       card: &str,
       lane: i32,
   ) -> String {
       use jackioh_engine::testkit::json;
       s.play(card, json!({ "zone": lane, "row": "backrow", "faceDown": "cloaked" }));
       s.backrow(player, lane).expect("the card set face-down by its Cloaked").id
   }
   ```

4. **Scripts.**
   - In each, drop the event fields that become unused, and add a one-line `// R783005:` comment at the read.
   - Delete an explicit `use jackioh_engine::catalog::def_of;` only when rustc says it is unused; Prison keeps it.
   - `P(s)` below is `played_type_of(s, event)`. Use `state` where the file has that local, else `&*ctx.state`.

   | Script (fn) | New check |
   |---|---|
   | c018, c005, c030, c023, c024 (`arrival`, the `CardResolved` arm) | `!*permanent \|\| P(state) != Some(CardType::Unit)` |
   | c014 `with_when`, c135 `answers`, t_ai_09 `opponent_played_a_unit` | `P(..) == Some(CardType::Unit)` |
   | c041 `with_when` | `if P(..) != Some(CardType::Unit) { return false; }`; the `§5.1` comment adds "or a Unit set by its Cloaked, a Field Trap play" |
   | c066 `arrive` | `Some(played) if played_type_of(&*ctx.state, played) == Some(CardType::Unit) => vec![summon_this()]` |
   | c034 | `matches!(P(..), Some(CardType::Unit \| CardType::FieldSpell))`, replacing `let type_` |
   | c068 `with_when` | `if P(..) != Some(CardType::Spell) { return false; }` |
   | c087 `tribal_play` | keep `def_id` (tags); the 4-line `matches!` becomes one: `if matches!(P(state), Some(CardType::Trap \| CardType::FieldTrap)) {`; its doc names `played_type_of` |
   | c037 `reaches_threshold` | `if !P(state).is_some_and(\|played\| NON_UNIT.contains(&played)) {`; `non_unit` untouched |
   | c006 | replace the two-line `let played` and its check with `if !P(&*ctx.state).is_some_and(\|played\| TRAP_TYPES.contains(&played)) { return vec![]; }`; header: "The play is read as it counts (`played_type_of`), so …" |

   - **c060 Bear Honeypot.**
     - In `ResolvedPlay`, `def_id: String` becomes `played_as: CardType`; `match_` sets `played_as: played_type_of(&*ctx.state, event)?`.
     - `tokens_and_attack` tests `played.played_as != CardType::Unit || !played.permanent`.
     - Rewrite the doc's "reads the def" sentence: the play as it counts, so a unit that died in its resolution counts and a Cloaked set is never attacked.
   - **c085 Unlicensed Experimentation.**
     - `played_permanent` returns `Option<(CardInstance, CardType)>`, ending `Some((card.clone(), played_type_of(&*ctx.state, event)?))`.
     - `run` and `when` destructur

## Goal

If a unit's own Brittle tick will destroy it at the start of its controller's next turn, before it can attack, the AI stops counting its attacks. It adds 0 to `face_threat` and to the evaluation's threat and pressure terms, and `could_attack_next_turn` rejects it, so `wall_switches` and `stands_down` offer no switch because of it. This holds for enemy units and for the AI's own.

These units still count:
- a unit whose first tick is not due yet;
- a unit the tick only lowers (count 2 or more);
- an Indestructible unit (R46);
- a unit of the player on turn when the evaluation reads that player as swinging first (`NextSwing`). That player attacks this turn, before any tick.

The new `EvalWeights` flag `brittle_crumbles_before_swing` turns this on. It is true in `AI_EVAL` and false in `GREEDY_EVAL`. `unit_worth` and `can_swing` do not change. Ruling R3793000 records the reading.

Get fuzz (3/4) and fuzz (4/4) of the daily super run green again. Both fail on the fuzz monitor's new I16 check, added by #3746. I ran the shards' own commands on a release build of `3d347d9`. Three seeds fail, each through a different engine leak:

- **Duos seed 1628 (fuzz 4/4):** C+ #31 Fusion Lab fuses S #16 Rod of Ages into C+ #65 Two Grapes, making a fused **Spell**. That Spell keeps Rod's end-of-turn hook ("gain random keywords"). `flag_return_to_hand_at_end_of_turn` flags any Spell with an `endOfTurn` hook for the end-of-turn return. So Rod's text runs from the graveyard and grants Poisonous to the card lying there.
- **Plain seed 6091 (fuzz 3/4):** a fused Unit's Cry exiles the card (C #44 Back from the GY's "Exile this"). A later #93 Combo-Index Cry part then writes `counters.grade` on the exiled card.
- **Plain seed 6140 (fuzz 3/4):** a fused Field Trap discards its chosen hand card. A later C+ #41 KY's Constant part then sets that card's cost, writing `costMod` on a graveyard card (against R766).

   ```rust
   /// R3800000: whether the running card stood off the field when the running script began and has not left
   /// the field since: a fused Spell's end-of-turn return run from its graveyard (R153, R155), and wherever
   /// that return moved it on to, never a card an earlier effect of the same run took off the field (R174).
   pub fn ran_off_the_field(ctx: &EffectContext<'_>) -> bool {
       let Some(this) = ctx.live_self() else {
           return false;
       };
       this.zone.z() != ZoneName::Field && !left_field_since(ctx, &this.id)
   }
   ```
   Why this works: `make_context` sets `exits_from` to the exit mark when the run starts. So a Unit+Unit fusion whose first end-of-turn part kills it still runs its second part, as it does today.

I can't see any run on the four-shard layout, so I can't tell whether each shard finishes under 5 minutes. The only change I can make here is to correct the stale comment above `[e2e]` in `scripts/ci-shards.toml`. A count above 4 cannot be shipped by the bot (see Open questions).

Get fuzz (3/4) and fuzz (4/4) of the daily super run green again. Both fail on the fuzz monitor's new I16 check, added by #3746. I ran the shards' own commands on a release build of `3d347d9`. Three seeds fail, each through a different engine leak:

- **Duos seed 1628 (fuzz 4/4):** C+ #31 Fusion Lab fuses S #16 Rod of Ages into C+ #65 Two Grapes, making a fused **Spell**. That Spell keeps Rod's end-of-turn hook ("gain random keywords"). `flag_return_to_hand_at_end_of_turn` flags any Spell with an `endOfTurn` hook for the end-of-turn return. So Rod's text runs from the graveyard and grants Poisonous to the card lying there.
- **Plain seed 6091 (fuzz 3/4):** a fused Unit's Cry exiles the card (C #44 Back from the GY's "Exile this"). A later #93 Combo-Index Cry part then writes `counters.grade` on the exiled card.
- **Plain seed 6140 (fuzz 3/4):** a fused Field Trap discards its chosen hand card. A later C+ #41 KY's Constant part then sets that card's cost, writing `costMod` on a graveyard card (against R766).

Every other wave of shards 3 and 4 passes. Done means:
- each leak is fixed in the engine and has its own ruling and a test named after it;
- the three seeds pass;
- shards 3 and 4 replay clean.

The fixes were prototyped outside the repo and turned all three seeds green.

`rust (test server)` finishes under the 8-minute target with headroom, by splitting it further or moving anything slow to the daily `super.yml`. The bot may not touch `.github/`.

  - `tests/server.rs`: 451 tests in 34.0 s.
  - `tests/server_store.rs`: 691 tests in 0.8 s.
  - The lib's 105 tests: 0.09 s.
  - `export_config`: 6 tests. `export_cosmetics`: 2 tests.
- **Slowest tests:** per-test times (`RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1 <server test binary> -Z unstable-options --report-time --skip api::`) show the slowest is `bots::seat::r2214000_a_strength_zero_miss_makes_far_fewer_beginners_mistakes_than_random` at 13.8 s. The next is 3.5 s and the rest are 2.4 s or less.

  - `server`: 30 s.

A count (`scripts/ci-shards.toml`) only divides the roughly 36 s run. `ci.yml` lists the tests with `cargo test … --list`, and every shard compiles the whole group first, so a count of 2 saves at most about 20–40 s on CI. Splitting by binary would not help either: the `server` and `server_store` binaries compile in parallel in 55 s, and the engine and cards compile dominates. Lowering the engine, cards and AI to opt-level 0 gave no gain (build 84 s + run 90 s = 174 s, against 125 s + 37 s = 162 s at opt-level 1).

- A count of 2 to 4, for the reasons above. The #3785 commit message says splits "that bought nothing" are unwelcome, and any count also breaks `bot selftest` (see **Risks**).
